messages:
Noah (SupplyOps): Port gridlock update: carrier says two H100 pallets are being held at the Rotterdam gateway due to yard congestion. They propose consolidating RMAs and re-routing via a single MAWB to reduce per-piece detention and brokerage. Need quick decision — eu provisioning schedule at risk.
Olga (Logistics): Post AWBs and weights. Consolidation usually saves ~€900 but can add 12-36h if the forwarder has to rework manifests.
Noah (SupplyOps): AWBs:
```
AWB: RT-554433-01 (31kg)
AWB: RT-554433-02 (32kg)
Proposed MAWB: RT-MAWB-1987
Carrier note: yard backlog 24-36h, consolidation reduces detention per pallet by ~€420.
```
Sam (Infra): These were scheduled for eu-west-1 capacity top-off this weekend. Thermal hold tolerance for returns is ~60h but freight handling spikes increase risk. If consolidation adds >24h we should flip to loaner routing from DE spare pool to avoid provisioning gap.
Rina (Procurement): Vendor suggests declared value €290k and asks for insurance sublimit at €200k if we consolidate. That under-insures. I won't accept reduced declared value without invoice proof. Also pushing vendor for brokerage credit under clause 4.2 (carrier misrouting).
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-1793. Please attach photos and original PO. Labels pending.
customs-bot: Consolidation OK but HTS classification check required. If reclassified to 8473.30 (computing machines) vs 8471.50 it can change duty profile for NL entry. House manifest must map original AWBs to MAWB for VAT reclaim.
Olga (Logistics): Forwarder can provide house manifest. Brokerage consolidated quote = €310 vs separate €1,250. They request declared value €200k for premium rate; we should decline.
Noah (SupplyOps): Risk policy: consolidate if (1) brokerage <= €400, (2) forwarder supplies house manifest, (3) procurement confirms declared value = invoice. Else ship separate.
Rina (Procurement): I'll require vendor invoice scan and PO amendment before declaring lower value. Also asking vendor for €600 credit if we accept consolidation per contract clause.
Sam (Infra): Contingency: ready DE->NL crossdock for 1 spare, ETA prep 8h. I'll trigger if manifest shows >18h delay. Monitoring set to alert on spare pool <40%.
Olga (Logistics): Manifest uploaded to RMA-1793: https://files.redwood/rma/1793/manifest_gridlock_v1.zip. Forwarder confirms consolidated brokerage €320 and house manifest included.
Rina (Procurement): Vendor sent invoice scan and agreed to €500 brokerage credit and to keep declared value = full invoice. I will record amendment under PO-3321-AMD4.
Noah (SupplyOps): Given brokerage €320, house manifest present, and vendor credit confirmed, proceeding with consolidation. Action items:
- Olga: finalize MAWB labels and confirm pick-up window.
- Rina: attach PO amendment to RMA and notify finance for insurance execption.
- Sam: stand by to trigger DE->NL crossdock if SLA degrades.
Olga (Logistics): On it. Scheduling pickup for evening hub run. :white_check_mark:
rma-bot: RMA-1793 status -> Consolidation accepted. Track under INC-2026-741.
Noah (SupplyOps): Thanks. Ping here for any customs or forwarder asks.
